section_heading: Data Movement and Conversion Instructions: mov
exact_quote:
Write register d with the value of a.
Operand a may be a register, special register, variable with optional offset in an addressable memory space, or function name.
reason_for_inclusion: Exact description of the base form: write register d with the value of a; operand a may be a register, special register, variable with optional offset, or function name.
